notes: This is a buyer-owned experimental procurement policy, not an Atinamos trust level.
Unknown does not mean unsafe. An unknown service may be explored only within the explicit exploratory price cap.
Evidence requirements apply to known services. Unknown-service price handling is enforced by the buyer harness using candidate information, not invented Atinamos evidence.
PAYMENT, FULFILMENT and assertion/correctness evidence remain separate dimensions.
Status changes to frozen only after the policy implementation and paired dry-run pass the pre-run gate.
